generated.details: On the mid-plane left tabletop, clear of the laptop, the small wooden model has thin basswood walls joined upright on a palm-sized rectangular base, with an open top revealing their connections.
Immediately beside it to the left, unlabelled color swatches are separate matte cards in muted cream, clay and sage, overlapping in a loose fan with exposed corners.
In the far-plane left against the side wall, the cropped flat-file cabinet has a steel carcass containing broad, shallow closed drawers with recessed pulls and no labels.
